rubric: Removing an added skill deletes its locally edited SKILL.md and drops the recovery record without --force or any conflict warning.
trigger: Add the two local skills with --choice only --consent scripts --apply, edit project/.agents/skills/notes/SKILL.md, then remove notes --apply without --force.
user_impact: The user loses custom instructions added after installation. The manager reports successful removal and removes the record rather than preserving the edit for recovery.
intended_lookalikes: Removing an unchanged added skill deletes the files installed for it.
Normal removal of an edited file should retain it and return partial with exit 3.
--force explicitly permits replacing or deleting edited files; --keep retains the edits and stops tracking them.
Manager-only projects do not install the full OAW helper set.
